name: web-orange-particle-sphere-with-glowing-trail-strokes-on-black
title: Black field with a sphere of tiny orange dots and glowing beaded trails that follow the cursor
whatItIs: A near-black canvas holding a loose spherical cloud of small orange dots and several glowing amber chains of larger beads curling through it, with a mouse cursor in the centre.
whatItMeans: Alive and organic; the dots and trails suggest energy responding to touch.
techniques: Leave glowing trails where the pointer passes.
Use one warm hue on black.
Vary bead size along the trail.

vocabulary.definition: Dots arranged on a spherical surface.
A glowing line left behind the cursor.
Circles of varying size in a line.
